fields.description: Detects execution of "csc.exe" to compile .NET code. Attackers often leverage this to compile code on the fly and use it in other stages.
fields.name: Dynamic .NET Compilation Via Csc.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\csc.exe" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains ":\\Perflogs\\" or tgt.process.cmdline
